Ogilvie and the spectacular view of the Upper Fraser Valley. We fly seven days a week, November to April, weather permitting. Make your reservation or order a gift certificate today! You and three of your friends can explore the breathtaking vistas of the Fraser Valley and experience the thrill of flying amongst the mountain peaks.
